overall.conclusion: No regression on these checks for the tested candidate; no demonstrated behavioral improvement. All formal assertions were non-discriminating between the two outputs.

limitations: Three fictional tasks, one run per configuration: no reliability or broad-generalization claim.
Fixture prompts already state important safeguards/delivery requirements, which may mask differences between authoring procedures.
Old small-library and revised CLI executors disclosed extra required repository orientation reads, violating the planned two-file-only boundary; this is exploratory, not perfectly controlled.
Executor model/variant and exact ambient context were not independently verified as identical.
No no-authoring-skill baseline, actual harness discovery trial, downstream package execution, or generator/installer/relocation execution was performed.
Executor summaries cannot independently prove all process claims; full raw outputs and grading reports were reviewed in the temporary evaluation workspace.
The final reviewer corrections received static checks only; comparisons apply to the explicitly hashed initial candidate.
Duration and token measurements unavailable; line-count changes do not establish cost savings.
Human output review and additional discriminating cases remain outstanding.
lifecycle_decision: Keep draft / medium. No promotion or validated-effectiveness claim.
